reports.title: O’REILLY AUTOMOTIVE, INC. REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Updated Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: The table below outlines the Company’s updated guidance for selected full-year 2026 financial data:

​ | ​ | ​
​ | ​ ​ ​ | For the Year Ending
​ | December 31, 2026
Net, new store openings | 225 to 235
Comparable store sales | 5.5% to 6.5%
Total revenue | $19.0 billion to $19.3 billion
Gross profit as a percentage of sales | 51.6% to 52.1%
Operating income as a percentage of sales | 19.5% to 20.0%
Effective income tax rate | 22.7%
Diluted earnings per share (1) | ​ | $3.25 to $3.35
Net cash provided by operating activities | ​ | $3.2 billion to $3.6 billion
Capital expenditures | ​ | $1.3 billion to $1.4 billion
Free cash flow (2) | ​ | $1.9 billion to $2.2 billion
